figures.caption: Figure 1. Framework comparison. Existing non-Omni methods like CnnSpot [81], SIDA [39], VideoLISA [6], and FakeSound [88] usually handle only single-modality inputs. In contrast, Omni-Fake-R1, built on a unified omni MLLM and our Omni-Fake dataset, supports four modalities, greatly expanding deepfake coverage. Classical non-MLLM pipelines also struggle to jointly handle detection, localization, and explanation, whereas Omni-Fake-R1 offers full support for integrated, trustworthy analysis of manipulated content.
